comparison.objective: Seat a robot-controller add-on board onto two pin rows without bending pins; the candidate configures a robot gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine multi-pin leveling and even axial insertion versus screw-angle adjustment, wrench seating, and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Board is fully seated, unbent, still, and released; candidate must hold a locked 90° opening through three functional cycles.
comparison.reason: Both concern robot assembly, but the record tests precision connector insertion rather than adjustable-stop calibration and retention.
